description: This file defines the AdminController class for handling SQL query operations within the OrchardCore framework, including executing and processing SQL queries with Liquid templating and authorization checks.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: Controller for managing SQL queries in OrchardCore, including executing queries with Liquid templating and authorization.

methods.name: Query (string query)
methods.description: Initializes a query view model with a Base64-decoded query string and connection factory info, then calls the main Query method.

methods.name: Query (AdminQueryViewModel model)
methods.description: Processes the SQL query, including authorization, parameter handling, Liquid templating, SQL parsing, execution, and error handling.
